test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On: 2 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is Blizard.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct spelling of 'Blizard' according to the English dictionary is 'B**lizzard**'.
 
• The word 'blizzard' means '**a very bad storm with strong winds and a lot of snow**'.
 
 
• *Example: We were snowed in by a raging **blizzard**.*
 
 
 
• Hence, the most appropriate answer is 'Blizard'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's understand the meaning of other options.

 
 
• **Brusque**- using very few words and sounding rude.
 
• **Boisterous**- (used about a person or behaviour) noisy and full of energy
 
• **Blonde**- (a person) with fair or yellow hair.
